title: Semer c'est s'aimer
bodyHtml:
Description:

Film commissioned in 2014 by the Jura General Council for the conference of the ODAS (National Observatory of Decentralized Social Action) about "shared gardens" in the Jura-France.

Images and production: Alexandra SANTANDER
Sound, editing and mixing: Didier Boyat
Music: Sueño en la Fabrica.
